title: Settings
description: Manage your account, study preferences and security.

profile.title: Profile
profile.timezoneHint: Streaks and daily goals reset at midnight in this timezone.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out of all other devices.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting your account permanently removes your projects, documents, progress and notes. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.description: All projects you own and everything in them will be deleted. Type {{word}} to confirm.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the interface, notifications and emails.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: Gamification should never get in the way of serious study.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Short, gentle sounds generated in your browser. Sounds are always off during exam simulations.

inApp.title: In-app notifications
inApp.description: Choose what QuizMe tells you about. Reminders respect your timezone and are sent at most once a day.

study_reminders.label: Study reminders
study_reminders.description: A nudge in the afternoon if you haven't studied yet

flashcards_due.label: Flashcards due
flashcards_due.description: When cards are waiting for review

streak_risk.label: Streak at risk
streak_risk.description: Evening reminder before your streak breaks

exams.label: Upcoming exams
exams.description: 7, 3 and 1 day before an exam date

goals.label: Study goals
goals.description: When you complete your daily goal

quiz_completion.label: Quiz results
quiz_completion.description: Summary after each quiz or exam simulation

invitations.label: Invitations
invitations.description: When someone invites you to a project

collaboration.label: Collaboration activity
collaboration.description: Shares, new members and project activity

email.label: Also send by email
email.description: Email copies of enabled notifications (invitations are always emailed)

sound_feedback.label: Answer feedback
sound_feedback.description: Correct / wrong sounds, card flips, XP ticks

sound_timers.label: Timers
sound_timers.description: Exam countdown ticks and study-room timers

animations_enabled.label: Animations
animations_enabled.description: Motion for feedback and celebrations (always reduced if your OS asks)

focus_mode.label: Focus mode
focus_mode.description: Hide celebrations, sounds, combos and XP popups. Progress is still tracked.

achievement_popups.label: Achievement popups
achievement_popups.description: Show a toast or modal when you unlock an achievement

leaderboard_opt_in.label: Appear on leaderboards
leaderboard_opt_in.description: Let collaborators see your weekly XP in shared projects

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account. Revoke any you don't recognise.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this session?
revokeDialog.description: That device will be signed out immediately.

othersDialog.title: Sign out everywhere else?
othersDialog.description_one: {{count}} other session will be signed out. You'll stay signed in here.
othersDialog.description_other: All {{count}} other sessions will be signed out. You'll stay signed in here.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.description: Generation is grounded in your own sources. Usage is tracked to keep costs under control.
aiUsage.caption: AI usage by task over the last 30 days

accountDeleted.title: Account deleted
accountDeleted.description: Your account and data have been removed.
